home.title: AxionIA
home.subtitle: Operational AI consultancy
home.description: On-site AI sessions, audits and implementation for companies.
home.heroDescription: We work on site in your company, map your real AI opportunities, deploy what creates value. You leave with measurable gains — not a POC, not a slide deck.
home.valueDescription: Pick your entry point based on your AI maturity. None commits you beyond the engagement — you test, you see, you decide.
home.value1Bullet1: AI diagnostic of your activity by a senior consultant
home.value1Bullet2: Live demos on your real data
home.value1Gain: You gain: instant clarity + actionable plan
home.value2Bullet1: Complete mapping of your processes and AI opportunities
home.value2Bullet3: Prioritised deployment plan PDF + 2h debrief workshop
home.value2Gain: You gain: informed decisions + controlled budget
home.value3Bullet1: Chatbot, AI agents, RAG, automations, custom AI
home.value3Bullet2: User testing with your operational staff
home.valueWhy1: No POC: we work on your real data from day 1.
home.valueWhy2: No lock-in: no subscriptions, no commitment, fixed quote.
home.valueWhy3: EU hosting: Hetzner Frankfurt, strict GDPR, DPO reachable.
home.valueWhy4: Estonian OÜ: European, transparent, compliant invoicing.
home.modulesDescription: Three entry points to integrate AI in your company — no risk, no commitment, at your own pace.
home.module1Description: One day on site with your team: diagnostic, AI demos, 90-day plan. From €490.
home.module2Description: Complete mapping of your AI opportunities, per-use-case costing, prioritised action plan. €290 to €1,990.
home.module3Description: Production deployment: chatbot, agents, RAG, automations, custom AI. From €990.
home.methodDescription: No engagement without a demo on your data. No costing without mapping. No deployment without support.
home.method1Description: Free discovery call to qualify your need and pick the right module.
home.method2Description: 1-day session, 5-day audit or 4-week prototype depending on the chosen module.
home.method3Description: Prioritised PDF deliverable: estimated ROI, complexity, deployment sequence.
home.method4Description: Implementation, user testing, go-live, 30-day support included.
home.casesDescription: Five real cases documented with context, problem, solution and post-delivery figures.
home.roiDescription: Four sliders, instant 12-month calculation. No personal data input required.
home.faqDescription: The five questions our consultants get during scoping calls.
home.ctaBlockDescription: One day on site, three quick-wins identified, costed 90-day plan. No AI prerequisite.
